name: workflow_interview
title: A module ask is interviewed, then drafted as "Your workflow" in the person's words

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open
steps.reply: I've put a question on your Home screen: what wasn't working about the Car Wash Site Scorecard tool you removed? Once I know that, I'll pick up the design properly rather than rebuilding the same thing.

steps.say: It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue and brief my investors. Sites come from brokers by email. Today I check households within 3 miles, density, drive-time population, the traffic on the road and at the main intersection, then I score fourteen things like visibility and access from 1 to 10 with a note each, and write a memo to investors. Thresholds: 45,000 households, 30,000 cars a day. Start with Austin. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply:
I've written up the workflow page — it's on your card now. It reuses the exact 14-item scorecard and the two gates from the version you built and removed, adds the density/drive-time-population and intersection-traffic pieces you just asked for, and flags the two things public data genuinely can't give you: a real drive-time-population API and intersection turning-movement counts (Austin's own counters are discontinued), so those are built as reasonable proxies, clearly labeled as estimates.
